morocco-tizi-n-tichka.slogan: Marrakech to Ouarzazate · one way, about 295 km back to the start

sections.advice: Marrakech → Taddert is 80 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Taddert → Tizi n Tichka climbs about 2260 m in 11 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Tizi n Tichka → Ait Benhaddou drops about 2260 m over 45 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Ait Benhaddou → Ouarzazate is 28 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

morocco-tizi-n-tichka.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Morocco Tizi n Tichka. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Tizi n'Tichka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2260 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Tizi n Tichka → Ait Benhaddou
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 2260 m come off over 81 km at around 5.0%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.

scenicChapters.title: Tizi n'Tichka Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: For 50 km this is Tizi n'Tichka Pass, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

morocco-tizi-n-tichka.story: From Marrakesh it runs 295 km to Ouarzazat; allow about 3 h 59 of riding. The stops in between: Taddert, Tizi n Tichka and Ait Benhaddou. The highest point is about 2,250 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
